dialogue.origin: （こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening, thank you for your time today.)

dialogue.origin: (こんばんは、よろしくお願いします)
dialogue.content: (Good evening, nice to meet you.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします。はじめに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. It's nice to meet you. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 17歳　女性　学校のことです
dialogue.content: I'm 17, female, and it's about school.

dialogue.origin: お返事ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: 学校のことで悩んでいるんですね。
dialogue.content: So you're having some trouble with school.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: どんなことがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me what happened?

dialogue.origin: お話ししやすいところからで、大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: You can start wherever you feel comfortable.

dialogue.origin: 先週、学校休んで次の日行ったんですけど、なんか省かれてる気がして
dialogue.content: I was absent from school last week, and when I went back the next day, it felt like I was being left out.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは不安になりますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel anxious.

dialogue.origin: 気のせいかなーとか思ったけど
dialogue.content: I wondered if I was just imagining it, but...

dialogue.origin: これから体育祭や球技大会あるし
dialogue.content: We have the sports festival and the ball games tournament coming up, and...

dialogue.origin: ええ、（聞いています）
dialogue.content: Mhmm, (I'm listening).

dialogue.origin: このままだと楽しめないし
dialogue.content: At this rate, I won't be able to enjoy them.

dialogue.origin: ３年生最後だから楽しくやりたかったけど、無理かな、、
dialogue.content: It’s my last year, my third year, so I wanted to have fun, but maybe that’s not possible...

dialogue.origin: ええ、そんなふうに感じているんですね。学校行事が盛りだくさんなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how you're feeling. It sounds like you have a lot of school events.

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: どんなところから、省かれているような感じかするのかな？
dialogue.content: What makes you feel like you're being left out?

dialogue.origin: なんか、、雰囲気かな
dialogue.content: It’s like... the atmosphere, I guess.

dialogue.origin: いつもと違ってる
dialogue.content: It's different from usual.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、、なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see... I understand.

dialogue.origin: 話しかけづらい
dialogue.content: It's hard to approach them.

dialogue.origin: そっか、、。何かきっかけがあったのかな？
dialogue.content: I see... Do you think something might have happened to cause this?

dialogue.origin: わかんなくて、、
dialogue.content: I don't know...

dialogue.origin: 聞いてないし
dialogue.content: I haven't asked.

dialogue.origin: なんか、、
dialogue.content: It’s just...

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Mhmm.

dialogue.origin: もういっかなーとか思ったりもしてバイト行くことをモチベにして頑張ってます。
dialogue.content: I sometimes think maybe it doesn't matter anymore, and I'm using my part-time job as motivation to keep going.

dialogue.origin: バイト、頑張っているんですね。
dialogue.content: You're working hard at your part-time job, aren't you?

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、
dialogue.content: By the way,

dialogue.origin: 高校２年生？
dialogue.content: Are you a second-year high school student?

dialogue.origin: 今3年です。
dialogue.content: I'm a third-year now.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.origin: そっか、最後にそんな雰囲気だと学校楽しめないね。
dialogue.content: I see. It must be hard to enjoy your last year of school with an atmosphere like that.

dialogue.origin: 1年生の時も2年生の時もこんなことあって、でも、理由とか、聞かなかったけどその時は自然に戻ったから
dialogue.content: Something like this happened in my first and second years too, but I didn't ask for the reason, and things went back to normal on their own then.

dialogue.origin: 今回も戻るかもしれないけど、、
dialogue.content: It might go back to normal this time too, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうなんだね。
dialogue.content: Mhmm, I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、
dialogue.content: But,

dialogue.origin: 不安だよね。
dialogue.content: it's still worrying, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: もういっかなーとかも思うから
dialogue.content: That's why I'm also thinking maybe I should just forget about it.

dialogue.origin: 何に悩んでるかも、わからなくなってる
dialogue.content: I'm not even sure what I'm worried about anymore.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、、。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 1人信用してる子いて
dialogue.content: There’s one person I trust.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、
dialogue.content: Mhmm.

dialogue.origin: その子とは話せてるし
dialogue.content: And I can talk to her.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね、同じクラス？
dialogue.content: I see. Is she in the same class?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、学校行くまでがしんどい
dialogue.content: But it's just so hard to get myself to go to school.

dialogue.origin: マジキツい
dialogue.content: It’s really tough.

dialogue.origin: 行っちゃえば、なんとか
dialogue.content: Once I’m there, I manage somehow.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか、毎日しんどくなっちゃうんだね。
dialogue.content: I see, I see. So it's a struggle every day.

dialogue.origin: うん、、でもしんどいね。
dialogue.content: Yes... but that must be hard.

dialogue.origin: 今年で最後だから、頑張りたいし
dialogue.content: This is my last year, so I want to try my best.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうだよね。でも、仲良しのお友達がいて、少し相談員は安心しますた。
dialogue.content: Mhmm, I understand. But I'm a little relieved to hear that you have a close friend.

dialogue.origin: 安心しました。　です。ごめんなさいね。
dialogue.content: I meant to say, “I felt relieved.” Sorry about that.

dialogue.origin: その子いなかったらムリ
dialogue.content: I couldn’t do it without her.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。そのお友達には相談してみたのかな？
dialogue.content: I can imagine. Have you tried talking to your friend about this?

dialogue.origin: 相談っていうかまぁ知ってるかな
dialogue.content: Not exactly "talking about it," but I think she knows.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お友達はなんて言ってくれてるの？
dialogue.content: What does your friend say about it?

dialogue.origin: なんにも、言わないよ。
dialogue.content: She doesn't say anything.

dialogue.origin: なんでだろう、、、気を遣ってくれてるのかな？
dialogue.content: I wonder why... Do you think she's trying to be considerate?

dialogue.origin: うーん、わかんないけど。多分、聞いちゃ悪いかなって思ってくれてるのかも
dialogue.content: Hmm, I’m not sure, but maybe she thinks it would be rude to ask.

dialogue.origin: 優しいお友達だね。
dialogue.content: She sounds like a kind friend.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。省いてくる子たちといる時よりちょっと楽かな
dialogue.content: She is. It's a little easier than being with the kids who are leaving me out.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうなんだね。
dialogue.content: Mhmm, I see.

dialogue.origin: なんでも話せそう？
dialogue.content: Do you feel like you can talk to her about anything?

dialogue.origin: うん、まぁ話せるかな
dialogue.content: Yeah, I guess I can.

dialogue.origin: どんなお話ししてるの？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things do you talk about?

dialogue.origin: 推しの話
dialogue.content: About our favorite idols.

dialogue.origin: 推し！？
dialogue.content: Your favorite idols?!

dialogue.origin: 誰だろう
dialogue.content: Who are they?

dialogue.origin: 友達はジャニオタでキンプリの箱推ししてて
dialogue.content: My friend is a Johnny’s fan and supports the whole group, King & Prince.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mhmm.

dialogue.origin: 私はスキズが好き
dialogue.content: And I like Stray Kids.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ、かっこいいんだね。
dialogue.content: I see, they’re cool, aren’t they?

dialogue.origin: そう格好いい！
dialogue.content: They are, they're so cool!

dialogue.origin: でも、お互いタイプ全然違う
dialogue.content: But our tastes are completely different.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、青春だね。そっか。
dialogue.content: Mhmm, that's what being young is all about. I see.

dialogue.origin: お互い好きなものをそのまま話せるから
dialogue.content: Because we can just talk freely about the things we each like,

dialogue.origin: だから、よけいに話が弾むのかな。
dialogue.content: So maybe that's why your conversations are so lively.

dialogue.origin: そうかも
dialogue.content: Maybe so.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか。教えてくれてありがとう。
dialogue.content: I see, I see. Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、学校のことで相談に来てくれたのだけど
dialogue.content: Today, you came to talk about what's happening at school,

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一番、辛いことはどんなことかな。
dialogue.content: What is the most difficult part for you?

dialogue.origin: 理由がわからないまま省かれたこと
dialogue.content: Being left out without knowing why.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: では、どうすればいいか
dialogue.content: So, let's think about what to do.

dialogue.origin: 一緒に考えさせてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Let's think about it together, okay?

dialogue.origin: お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 少しでも、あなたが楽になれる方法を考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.content: Let’s look for ways to make things even a little easier for you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, let's work on this together.

dialogue.origin: 学校を休んだのは風邪を引いたからなのかな？または違う理由とかあるのかな。
dialogue.content: Did you miss school because you had a cold? Or was there another reason?

dialogue.origin: 風邪かわかんないけど、体調悪くて休みました。
dialogue.content: I'm not sure if it was a cold, but I felt unwell and took the day off.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: どんな感じだったの？
dialogue.content: What did it feel like?

dialogue.origin: 体がだるくて、頭もぼーっとする感じ
dialogue.content: My body felt heavy, and my head felt foggy.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか、、それは辛かったね。
dialogue.content: I see, I see... That must have been tough.

dialogue.origin: 今日は、体調大丈夫？
dialogue.content: Are you feeling okay today?

dialogue.origin: 具合が悪かった時も熱なかったし、今日はもう大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: I didn't have a fever when I felt sick, and I'm fine today.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね、ひとまずよかったけど、、、。時々体調がしんどいとかあるのかな？
dialogue.content: I see—I'm glad to hear that for now... Do you sometimes struggle with your health like that?

dialogue.origin: うーん、疲れてる時はあるかなでも、学校は行ってる。
dialogue.content: Hmm, maybe when I'm tired. But I still go to school.

dialogue.origin: えらいね、頑張っているんだね。
dialogue.content: That's admirable. You're really trying hard.

dialogue.origin: 最後だから、頑張りたいし。
dialogue.content: It's my last year, so I want to do my best.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、すごい。
dialogue.content: Mhmm, that's amazing.

dialogue.origin: でも、頑張りすぎてないかな？
dialogue.content: But I wonder if you might be pushing yourself too hard?

dialogue.origin: そうなのかなーみんな普通にやってるから
dialogue.content: I wonder... Everyone else seems to be doing it just fine.

dialogue.origin: そっか、、。休みの後、
dialogue.content: I see... After you were absent,

dialogue.origin: みんなの雰囲気が違ったんだよね、、。
dialogue.content: the atmosphere among everyone felt different, right?

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: なんでだろうね、、、。
dialogue.content: I wonder why that is...

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、
dialogue.content: By the way,

dialogue.origin: あなたは、どんな係とかしているのかな？
dialogue.content: what kind of committee or role do you have at school?

dialogue.origin: 図書委員です
dialogue.content: I'm on the library committee.

dialogue.origin: そっか、本が好きなんだね。
dialogue.content: I see, you like books, don't you?

dialogue.origin: まぁまぁかな
dialogue.content: They're okay, I guess.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mhmm.

dialogue.origin: 少し聞いてもいい？
dialogue.content: May I ask you something?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: あなた自身では、どんな性格だと思うかな？
dialogue.content: How would you describe your own personality?

dialogue.origin: 考えたことあんまりないけど
dialogue.content: I haven’t really thought about it much, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん、頑張り屋さんの他には、、、
dialogue.content: Mhmm, besides being a hard worker...

dialogue.origin: あんまり自分の意見言わないかも
dialogue.content: I guess I don't really state my own opinion much.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 言いたいときは、どうしてるの？
dialogue.content: When you do want to say something, what do you do?

dialogue.origin: うーん。グループでいる時は合わせる
dialogue.content: Hmm. When I'm in a group, I just go along with everyone.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか。
dialogue.content: I see, I see.

dialogue.origin: グループで話しているとき、
dialogue.content: When you're talking in a group,

dialogue.origin: 嫌だなーって思ったこともあると思うのだけど、、
dialogue.content: I imagine there have been times you've felt you didn't like something...

dialogue.origin: そんなときは、どうしてるの？
dialogue.content: What do you do in those situations?

dialogue.origin: 嫌だなーって思ったことなかったかな？、、ごめんね。
dialogue.content: Or maybe you haven't felt that way? ...I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: いや、いつと誰かが自分と同じ気持ちだったりするから
dialogue.content: No, it's because there's always someone who feels the same way I do,

dialogue.origin: あんまり自分が言う時が少なかったかな
dialogue.content: so there haven't been many times I've had to say it myself.

dialogue.origin: いつと誰か？きっと誰か　かな？
dialogue.content: You said “itsu to dareka”? Did you mean “itsumo dareka (always someone)”?

dialogue.origin: いつも誰かが　でした
dialogue.content: I meant, “there’s always someone.”

dialogue.origin: なるほど。あんまり自分から喋る時が少ないんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you don't often initiate conversations yourself.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.origin: 自分から、喋る時ってどんな感じ？
dialogue.content: When you do speak up, what is that like?

dialogue.origin: 緊張するとか、、、楽しいとか
dialogue.content: Do you feel nervous... or is it enjoyable?

dialogue.origin: どんな感じかな、、推しの話をする時は明るく話してると思うけど
dialogue.content: I wonder... When I talk about my favorite idols, I think I talk cheerfully.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mhmm.

dialogue.origin: どちらかと言うと聞いてる方が多いかも
dialogue.content: But I'm probably the listener more often than not.

dialogue.origin: ノリっていうか
dialogue.content: It's the vibe, you know?

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: みんなノリ良くて
dialogue.content: Everyone has a really high-energy vibe,

dialogue.origin: ノリって大事だよね。
dialogue.content: That kind of vibe is important, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 乗りそびれる
dialogue.content: and I miss the chance to join in.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか。
dialogue.content: I see, I see.

dialogue.origin: 少し、相談員が思ったことを
dialogue.content: There's something that occurred to me.

dialogue.origin: 話してもいいですか？
dialogue.content: May I share it with you?

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: あなたは、頑張り屋さんだし、人の話をしっかり聞ける優しい人なので
dialogue.content: You're a hard worker, and you're a kind person who can listen carefully to others.

dialogue.origin: もしかすると、お話のテンポなのかもしれないと思いましたが、、、どうかな？
dialogue.content: I was thinking that perhaps it might just be about the tempo of the conversation... what do you think?

dialogue.origin: かもしれませんね。楽しくしてるつもりだけど
dialogue.content: That might be it. I try to have fun, though.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そのままでいいと私は思いますよ。
dialogue.content: Mhmm, and I think it's perfectly fine to be just the way you are.

dialogue.origin: みんなに合わせる必要なんてないと相談員は思います。
dialogue.content: I don't think you need to force yourself to match everyone else's pace.

dialogue.origin: いいんですかね…
dialogue.content: Is that really okay...?

dialogue.origin: うん、あなたは何も悪くないもの。
dialogue.content: Yes, because you haven't done anything wrong.

dialogue.origin: それに、仲良いお友達もいるでしょう。
dialogue.content: Besides, you have a good friend, don't you?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s true.

dialogue.origin: 雰囲気が似た者同士が集まりやすい。
dialogue.content: People with a similar vibe tend to gather together.

dialogue.origin: たしかにそうですね。無理しなくて楽だし。
dialogue.content: That's definitely true. It's easier because I don't have to force myself.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうですよ。
dialogue.content: Mhmm, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 時間が、なくなってきました。
dialogue.content: We’re almost out of time.

dialogue.origin: 今日、お話ししてどうでしたか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.origin: このままで良いって言ってもらえたから
dialogue.content: Because you told me it's okay to be myself,

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: 気持ちが楽になった気がします。
dialogue.content: I feel like a weight has been lifted.

dialogue.origin: そう言っていただけて、私も嬉しいです。
dialogue.content: I'm happy to hear you say that.

dialogue.origin: また、不安なことがあったらここにきてくださいね。
dialogue.content: If you feel anxious again, please feel free to come back.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: No, thank you.

dialogue.origin: では、本日はここで終了しますね。
dialogue.content: Well then, we'll end our session for today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much.)
